sections.title: Form and habitat
sections.text: Poet's narcissus is a bulbous perennial of central and southern Europe, often growing in wet meadows. It is usually 20–40 cm tall, sometimes taller, and flowers in spring.

sections.title: Flower
sections.text: The flower stalk usually bears a solitary white flower 4–6 cm across, with a small yellow corona edged in red. The bulb produces linear leaves.

sections.title: Toxicity
sections.text: Narcissi contain toxic alkaloids; the bulb is particularly dangerous if eaten. Do not consume any part of the plant.
